findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: -Inspector observed the top of the dish machine to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC. PIC has cleaned the machine since the last inspection, but the soils have built up again. Inspector recommends increasing frequency of dish machine cleanings. Ensure the top of the dish machine is cleaned regularly enough to keep it free of soils.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the top of the dish machine to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC, area will be cleaned. Ensure all non food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency that prevent accumulation. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
